literal.text:
On 31 August 2023 the Council adopted France's draft S/2023/641 as resolution 2695 (2023) by 13 votes in favour, none against and two abstentions, China and Russia [vote]. It renewed UNIFIL's existing mandate through 31 August 2024 and reaffirmed independent action within that mandate without prior permission, with continued coordination with Lebanon's Government under the status-of-forces agreement [operative].

Brazil said the draft preserved UNIFIL's freedom to operate and addressed some Lebanese concerns [brazil].

China said the text fell short on Lebanon's concerns and emphasized sovereignty and consent in peacekeeping [china].

Brazil saw some Lebanese concerns addressed. China found the response insufficient [brazil, china].

literal.text:
The Council adopted draft S/2022/980 as resolution 2669 (2022) by 12 votes in favour, none against and three abstentions by China, India and Russia [vote]. It demanded an immediate end to violence, called for humanitarian access and acknowledged ASEAN's central role. It requested an oral report to the Council by 15 March 2023 from the Secretary-General or his Special Envoy, in coordination with the ASEAN Special Envoy, on UN support for the Five-Point Consensus [mandate].

India abstained, citing neighbours' concerns and advocating quiet, constructive diplomacy [vote, india].
